description: Developer states an EIA Scoping Report for the CX Technology Campus was submitted in March 2026, with a full Environmental Impact Assessment underway. Reference and scoping opinion could not be verified: the council ePlanning portal blocked automated access on 2026-07-30.

events.title: EIA Scoping Report submitted (developer-stated, March 2026; exact date unknown)

description: Statutory-style pre-application community consultation is underway ahead of a Planning Permission in Principle application targeted for December 2026 (a PAN is required at least 12 weeks before a major application in Scotland, but no PAN reference has been located). Consultation events: Victoria Halls, Annan 12 May 2026 and Creca Hall 13 May 2026; second round Creca Village Hall 16 June 2026 and Victoria Halls, Annan 17 June 2026.

events.title: First consultation event, Victoria Halls, Annan
